create_math_handler_mixin: create a MathHandlerMixin that processes LaTeX math nodes and converts them to DoclingDocument formula nodes
build_math_node_processing: build math node processing that distinguishes display math from inline math and adds formula nodes to the document
clean_latex_math_string: clean a LaTeX math string by stripping delimiters, removing labels, and expanding macros
expand_latex_macros: expand LaTeX macros in a math string using the _expand_macros helper method
process_inline_math_content: process inline math content by expanding macros and appending to a text buffer for later flushing
